mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signal robust household demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increased by ≥1% MoM, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contraction (INDPRO < 108.0), manufacturing bottlenecks intensify, eroding corporate profitability and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 108.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month consistently lowers risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payroll growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS > 200000 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal robust economic expansion and strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and GDPC1 both increased by ≥1% QoQ, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), restrictive policy increases real interest rates and dampens equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
